# Using discovered material

Finding a logo, stylesheet, competitor pattern or admired website does not make it correct for the current landing.

For every finding that could change the result, record in `research-strategy.md`:

- what was found and where;
- whether it will be used, changed or ignored;
- the project reason;
- any constraint or unresolved uncertainty;
- which downstream owner needs it.

Preserve useful brand equity and facts, but challenge material that conflicts with the objective, audience, accessibility or desired perception. External references provide principles, never a page to copy.
